responses.text:
Hi Atlas team, thanks for reviewing Codex Bilingual Reader. Could you recheck the `download-exec` finding for v1.6.0? The [report summary](https://github.com/iliasbeshimov/zoteroplugins.org/blob/main/data/generated/codex-bilingual-reader/1.6.0.json#L1190-L1202) says the downloads aren’t checked against a fingerprint fixed in the plugin, but the [underlying scan](https://github.com/iliasbeshimov/zoteroplugins.org/blob/main/data/generated/codex-bilingual-reader/1.6.0.json#L800-L828) records SHA-256 pinning.

- On Windows, the [PowerShell installer](https://github.com/fangchenghao/codex-bilingual-reader/blob/v1.6.0/scripts/install-preserved-pdf-runtime.ps1#L8-L59) checks the PDF engine archive against a hard-coded SHA-256 digest before extraction. It uses the [same verification helper for the Node.js download](https://github.com/fangchenghao/codex-bilingual-reader/blob/v1.6.0/scripts/install-preserved-pdf-runtime.ps1#L76-L89).
- On macOS and Linux, the [shell installer](https://github.com/fangchenghao/codex-bilingual-reader/blob/v1.6.0/scripts/install-preserved-pdf-runtime.sh#L44-L91) checks the Node.js and uv downloads against platform-specific SHA-256 digests before extraction.

Both tagged installer files match the sizes and SHA-256 hashes in [Atlas’s XPI inventory](https://github.com/iliasbeshimov/zoteroplugins.org/blob/main/data/generated/codex-bilingual-reader/1.6.0.json#L87-L96). The separate dependency finding is outside this request: the direct Python requirements are pinned, but the transitive dependency tree is not fully locked.

Could you update the fingerprint wording, or point me to the specific download path that bypasses verification if the finding refers to a different path? Thanks.
responses.reply:
Thanks for the careful check. You were right, and your installers do what you said: both check every download against a SHA-256 written into the plugin before anything is unpacked or run.

Our scanner got your shell installer wrong in two places. It only recognised a digest written in quotes, and yours are bare (`digest=8294b7aa…`), so it marked that download unchecked. It also didn't follow the versions you set at the top of the script, so it read `pdf2zh_next==$PDF2ZH_VERSION` and the others as unpinned. And it didn't know files.pythonhosted.org is PyPI's file server. All three are fixed, for every plugin.

Codex Bilingual Reader is now graded B: https://zoteroplugins.org/p/codex-bilingual-reader. The downloads count as checked against a fixed fingerprint, and the Python packages as fixed versions. Those, and starting Codex CLI and the installer scripts, are medium findings, and B is the highest grade a plugin that installs packages and runs programs can get under our rules. So there's nothing more you need to change for it.

If you'd like to show it in your README:

```
[![Zotero Plugins grade](https://zoteroplugins.org/badge/codex-bilingual-reader.svg)](https://zoteroplugins.org/p/codex-bilingual-reader)
```
